findings.design: Combined Name cell shows an avatar with initials derived from the person's name (e.g. 'JD') next to the actual full name ('Jamie Delacroix'), in a dedicated Name column.
findings.app: A separate 'Name' <td> exists but is hardcoded to the placeholder em-dash '—' for every row; there is no `name` field on `AdminUserListItem` at all, so it can never be populated.
findings.evidence: openspec/design/admin-content.jsx:314-315 (UsersScreen row, u.name) vs apps/web/app/components/admin/AdminUsers.vue:124 (`—`) and packages/shared/src/admin/index.ts:38-43 (AdminUserListItem has no name field)

findings.design: Last active column shows relative activity timestamps per user (e.g. 'Today', 'Yesterday', '3 days ago', '1 week ago').
findings.app: Column header exists but the cell is hardcoded to '—' for every row; `AdminUserListItem` has no last-active/lastLoginAt field to source this from.

findings.design: Remove button is rendered as a fully active, clickable destructive action (red border/text, no disabled styling) alongside Promote/Demote.
findings.app: Remove button is permanently `disabled`, styled muted/`cursor-not-allowed`, and has no click handler at all — the action is not implemented.
findings.evidence: openspec/design/admin-content.jsx:321 (Remove button, red border rgba(248,113,113,0.25), no disabled state) vs apps/web/app/components/admin/AdminUsers.vue:176-183 (`disabled` attribute, `cursor-not-allowed`, `text-red-500/60`)

findings.design: Invite user button is rendered as a normal active affordance (bordered button, standard text color) in the toolbar.
findings.app: Invite user button is permanently `disabled` with muted styling and `cursor-not-allowed` — no invite flow is wired up.
findings.evidence: openspec/design/admin-content.jsx:308 (Invite user button, no disabled state) vs apps/web/app/components/admin/AdminUsers.vue:93-100 (`disabled` attribute, text-slate-500)

findings.design: Search field is depicted for filtering the user table (readOnly only because it's a static mockup).
findings.app: Search input renders but has no `v-model`, no `@input` handler, and no filtering logic wired to the users list — it is decorative only.
findings.evidence: openspec/design/admin-content.jsx:307 (input readOnly, mockup placeholder) vs apps/web/app/components/admin/AdminUsers.vue:83-88 (plain `<input type="search">` with no binding)

findings.design: Avatar is a neutral circle (elevated background, bordered) with accent-colored initials derived from the user's name (e.g. split on space, first letters).
findings.app: Avatar is a solid `bg-readion-primary` circle with white text, and initials are derived from the email address (`emailInitials(user.email)`) since no name field exists.
findings.evidence: openspec/design/admin-content.jsx:315 (T.elevated bg, T.accent text, name.split(' ')) vs apps/web/app/components/admin/AdminUsers.vue:126-132 (bg-readion-primary, emailInitials(user.email))

findings.design: Summary text ('12 users · 2 admins') sits on the left; search input + Invite button are grouped together on the right.
findings.app: Search input sits on the left; summary text + Invite button are grouped together on the right — the two groups are transposed relative to the design.
findings.evidence: openspec/design/admin-content.jsx:304-310 (summary span first, then search+invite div) vs apps/web/app/components/admin/AdminUsers.vue:82-102 (input first, then summary+invite div)

findings.design: Admin role badge uses a warning/amber color scheme (orange background+border+text) to visually distinguish privileged accounts.
findings.app: Admin role badge uses the primary/blue brand color (`bg-readion-primary/15 text-readion-primary`) instead of an amber/warning tone.
findings.evidence: openspec/design/admin-content.jsx:290-294 (RoleBadge: T.warn amber for admin) vs apps/web/app/components/admin/AdminUsers.vue:136-148 (bg-readion-primary/15 text-readion-primary)

findings.design: Screen title 'Users' sits in a distinct header bar with its own elevated background and bottom border, separating it from the scrollable content region below.
findings.app: Title is a plain `<h1>` inline with the rest of the content in one flex column, with no distinct header bar/background/border treatment.
findings.evidence: openspec/design/admin-content.jsx:300-302 (header div with T.elevated bg + border-bottom, padding 14px 28px) vs apps/web/app/components/admin/AdminUsers.vue:67-68 (`<section class="flex flex-col gap-6">` + plain `<h1>`)

findings.design: Column is labeled 'Email' and shown as its own dedicated column (mono font) separate from Name.
findings.app: Column is labeled 'User' (not 'Email') and combines the avatar + email together, filling the role that 'Name' should have played.
